knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Missing specified parts are recorded and obtained. Nails and substitutes are not used for shelves that will carry load.
Misalignment usually means a step was missed or a part is wrong. The worker stops and checks.
The lesson says to open the delivery and count the parts against the parts list and the packing list before assembly, and not to assemble from a partial set.

practicalCriteria: Given a simulated flat-pack delivery with one missing part, the worker counts the parts against the list, records the missing item and does not substitute.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A part is missing and substitution is requested
A part is damaged in a way that affects safe use
